profile.description: Al Anwar Investments SAOG is a private equity firm specializing in providing in PIPES and in growing sectors and secondary market. The firm also invests in small-to medium-sized businesses. The firm prefers to invest in financial services and insurance with secondary focus on the energy and industrial sectors. The firm typically invests in companies based in Oman, Middle East, and in the GCC markets United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait and Bahrain. The firm prefers to take a board representation. It prefers to exit its investment through stake sale, IPO, and swap/merger. Al Anwar Holdings SAOG was founded in 20th December 1994 and is based in Muscat,Oman.
